round1_text:
1) **Final recommended crop**: Jute - selected due to highest adjusted confidence (0.087) after RAG reranking and calendar adjustment, despite low raw model confidence.

2) **Confidence interpretation**: Raw model confidence was 0.240, but adjusted confidence dropped to 0.087 after incorporating RAG suitability (0.375) and calendar factors. This is well below the 0.6 threshold for reliable recommendations.

3) **Top-3 tradeoff note**: Jute (0.087) narrowly leads cotton (0.024) and blackgram (0.024), but all three crops show similar RAG suitability scores (0.375) and low adjusted confidences, indicating high uncertainty in the ranking.

4) **Action checklist**:
   • Verify soil nutrient levels (N:110, P:55, K:65) match jute requirements
   • Confirm February planting timing aligns with local jute sowing windows
   • Conduct field trials before large-scale adoption due to low confidence

5) **Risk warning**: Low confidence recommendation (0.087 < 0.6) with model disagreement detected. Manual agronomy review strongly recommended before implementation.
